chunks.title: Chicken_Thecha_Marathi_Style
chunks.text: Hello everyone, Assalamualaikum, welcome back to my channel Indian Kitchen Asma Today I am going to make Chicken Thecha This is a Marathi dish If you like my recipe then please like and subscribe to my channel First of all, I will show you the ingredients I have washed and washed the chicken These are some peanuts Lemon, Curry leaves, Green chili, Garlic, Ginger, Coriander, Cloves I will grind it with fine paste Onion, Oil, Cumin, Coriander, Turmeric, Salt First of all, I will put some oil in the pan Then I will put the chicken I will roast it I will put some ginger and garlic paste I will put some green chili I will put some coriander leaves I will turn off the flame I will grind it when it cools down I will not grind it in the pan It will not taste good When it cools down I will fry the chicken I will put some oil in the pan Oil should be sweet and refined Like the one of the chicken Mustard oil should not be used When it is hot, I will put cumin seeds Let the flavor of cumin seeds come I will put some curry leaves I have kept the onion in the pan It is cooked It has changed its color It has become raw Now I will put the chicken I will cook it I will put the masala I will put the green chili I will put the ginger and garlic paste I will put the curry leaves I will put the turmeric I will put salt I will put coriander leaves I will put the red chili powder I will put salt and pepper I will mix it I will cook it on low flame I will cook it on low flame I have kept the chicken in the pan I will put the masala I will put the green chili I will put the onion I will put the green chili I will put the ginger and garlic paste I have kept the chicken in the pan I will put the chicken I am changing the flame I am changing the flame It will grind It should crush It has been crushed See it has been crushed It will take a few minutes It will take 6 to 7 minutes It has been crushed It has been crushed It has been crushed I will mix it I'll cook this too, now add vinegared barrelsya leaves, здоровоrada consumo mix them properly now i'll cover this for 3-4 minutes keep it aside Add the fried vegetables Our chicken sevda is ready If you like my recipe, please like and share it and subscribe to my channel
